annotations.text:
I — ORION
Straight from your second reference. Tabbed frame headers welded to each bay, orange as a co-equal channel to the teal, bar clusters and matrix grids as texture, a waveform rail across the bottom, and the reactor sitting inside a tracking disc with a point cloud and labelled contacts.
Keeps your three-column layout. Densest and most numeric of the three.

J — HOLO ORB
From your first reference. The reactor floats inside an orbital shell with a particle field and a full-frame reticle, soft rounded glass panels lifted off the background, and an icon dock along the bottom.
Most cinematic, least dense. Reads as a projection rather than a console.

K — DEEP SCAN
The ORION planet-tracker panel, applied to the whole screen. Deliberately asymmetric: one large scanning display holds the reactor at its heart with tracked contacts and leader lines, while the right half is a tight telemetry grid and the bottom is a waveform and spectrum bank.
Most technical. Breaks the symmetry you have now.
The arc reactor is unchanged in all three — same ten coil segments, same housing ring, same hot centre. Only what surrounds it differs.
